steps.text: Hold the calibration board flat in front of the camera, filling about half the picture
Move the board slowly closer and further away
Tilt the board left and right, slowly
Tilt the board up and down, slowly
Move the board to the left side of the picture
Move the board to the right side of the picture
Move the board to the top of the picture
Move the board to the bottom of the picture
Turn the board slowly, like a steering wheel
